name: On Love, On Monsters
source:
A Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4189160/On_Love_On_Monsters/]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部受《弗兰肯斯坦》启发、聚焦于世间百态之“爱”的叙事作品。你将以交替切换的视角扮演三名角色：医生、神父与流亡者。在布莱克摩尔镇与盟友及宿敌建立羁绊，小心行事以免引人怀疑，并在旅途中领悟爱的真谛。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4189160/On_Love_On_Monsters/]itch.io[/url]]
